pageSize.description: Maximum number of events per page; the server picks a default when omitted.

pageToken.description: `nextPageToken` from a previous response, to fetch the next page.

trustedOnly.description: When `true`, returns only events from trusted peers; all peers by default.

filterAuthors.description: Account uids to include events from; multiple authors match with OR logic.

filterEventType.description: Event types to include, such as `Ref`, `Capability`, `Comment`, `Contact` or `doc/Link`; OR logic.

filterResource.description: Resource id to include events for; accepts wildcards to match path prefixes.

currentAccount.description: Viewer's account uid, used to show that account's contact names for authors in the events.

order.description: Feed ordering: `claimed` (default) by the event's claimed time, `observed` by when the server received the blob.

input.description: Paging, filter, and ordering options for the feed.

events.description: Activity events on this page, with their referenced entities loaded.

nextPageToken.description: Token for the next page; empty when there are no more events.

description: Pages through the activity feed as activity events, filtered by author, event type, or resource, with a token for the next page.
